key.name: api-key
key.description: API key used to call the Gemini generateContent endpoint. Get one at https://aistudio.google.com/apikey.

key.name: model
key.description: Model id used for transcription requests.

key.name: custom-prompt
key.description: If not empty, replaces the built-in transcription prompt sent along with the audio.

key.name: price-overrides
key.description: Optional JSON object keyed by model id, USD per 1M tokens, merged over the built-in table. Example: {"gemini-3.1-flash-lite": {"text": 0.25, "audio": 0.5, "output": 1.5}}
